predictions: Aw, man, that stunk… One week after my first week better than 17-8, I put up first week worse than 17-8. A passable but still pedestrian 16-9 last week brings me to 102-48 (which is right back at a flat 68% correct for the season, which has been my exact rate after 4 of the 6 weeks so far). The weird part last week was that, in addition to all my standard close losses (two 1001s, two 13-11s, two 14-10s), I actually got a couple matches really wrong. And I mean really, really wrong.

Match of the week: (G Div.) We're Sexy & We Throw It @ Death Throw. After barely hanging on to an F (now G) spot last season, We Throw It is just making winning a habit (despite some previously key players now mostly absent?!). Meanwhile, Death Throw is undefeated and way ahead in G, despite being next to last in the division in ASPs. G division is… a pretty weird place, man. I guess I'll go with DT, 14-10.

Match #2: (H Div.) Bangin the Wire @ Darts In the Wind, Dude! After a couple disappointing seasons, Bangin is putting it all back together this time around. Here they have a chance to knock another of the chase group a full three matches behind. In The Wind is a fine team, but the one thing aren't is… Bangin. The next Bangin win is 16-8.

Match #3: (A Div.) The Hunted Element @ Jonesing for Mugs. The best way for A to be dramatic in the second half was for Element to win last week over Show Me, and then to lose to Jonesing this week. But with the way my guys showed up last week, I gotta go Element, 14-10.

Match #4: (C Div.) Big Duck Energy @ Bottoms Up. The Ducks are quite good, and their mini losing streak was already interrupted. But this season is just another rung on the ladder for the Bottoms, who are destined to fight it out in B next season. Bottoms power onward, 15-9.

Match #5: (D Div.) Shooter McGavin @ Nine Lives. Is Area 501 already out of reach? Nah, there is still time for somebody to make a run at them. And it could be this match's winner. It's Niners, 13-11.
Match #6: (E Div.) That's What She Said @ Ton 80 Proof. With the middle pack of 5 E teams fighting for everything from 2nd to a fall to F next season, there are a LOT of key matches. Ton 80, 13-11.
Match #7: (A Div.) Wing & a Plaque @ Why So Serious? A very good team will finish 5th in A and earn its A slot for the fall. And a good team will also lose here and terrorize B soon. Serious, 14-10.

Match #8: (C Div.) Pints & Points @ Darty Little Secrets. It's not very far from these teams to 2nd place in B, but they're even closer to living in C's bottom pair. The Pints are ready to move up, 13-11.
Match #9: (G Div.) Aim For Fame @ Sofa Kings. Head to head tangle to avoid a bottom-two spot at the midway point. I'm feeling like Fame might climb not just one, but two, spots tonight. 14-10.
Match #10: (B Div.) Kids On The Fringe @ Hump Day! Hump Day just lost and their lead is in danger. Now they face a Kids squad that seems to get better with each player absence. Humpers, 12-10.

Match #11: (F Div.) Rippin Darts @ Heart of Dartness. F is so odd that this winner could be immediately fighting for 2nd, while the loser might be immediately battling to avoid a G spot. Rippin, 13-11.
Match #12: (D Div.) Rif Raf @ One Armed Bandits. Somehow, the loser here might very soon be staring at a drop to E division. Rif Raf has been tanking me lately, but I'm still with them here, 13-11.
And the remaining 13 matches, sorted by division:
A Division: Show Me Your Tips 19, Consistently Inconsistent 5.
B Division: Darty 15, Projectile 9; Buffalo Bulls 13, Possee 11.
C Division: Darty Sanchez 15, Double In Stumble Out 9.
D Division: Menace 13, Mayhem 9; Area 501 15, Breakfast Club 9.
E Division: Constantly 13(!), Arrows 11; Bad News 13, Knights 11.
F Division: Corks 15, Cheap Shots 9; One Time 15, Wayward 9.
G Division: Sharky's Machine 14, Nein Mark 10.
H Division: Flight Club 14, Salute 10; Bright Side 14, The Blind 10.
